name: Air Jordan 1 Retro High
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High is an iconic basketball sneaker with a classic high-top silhouette, premium leather upper, and bold colorways that have defined sneaker culture for decades.

name: Air Jordan 1 Low
description: The Air Jordan 1 Low brings iconic Jordan style in a sleek low-top profile, perfect for everyday wear with premium leather construction and Air-Sole cushioning.

name: Air Jordan 3 Retro
description: Featuring elephant print overlays and a visible Air unit in the heel, the Air Jordan 3 Retro is a landmark in sneaker design and a must-have for collectors.

name: Yeezy Boost 350 V2
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 features a Primeknit upper and full-length BOOST midsole, delivering next-level comfort and Kanye West's signature minimalist aesthetic.

name: Yeezy Boost 700
description: The chunky Yeezy 700 'Wave Runner' blends mesh, suede, leather and BOOST technology in one bold statement shoe that sparked the dad shoe trend.

name: Yeezy Slides
description: The Yeezy Slides feature an anatomically shaped EVA foam footbed in a one-piece design, offering supreme comfort for casual wear.

name: New Balance 550
description: The New Balance 550 is a retro basketball sneaker from 1989, reimagined with a clean leather upper and smooth colour-blocked panels for a timeless look.

name: New Balance 990v5
description: Made in the USA, the New Balance 990v5 is the gold standard in running heritage shoes, built with a ENCAP midsole and premium pigskin suede.

name: New Balance 2002R
description: The NB 2002R delivers a refined running silhouette with N-ergy midsole cushioning wrapped in a clean suede and mesh upper.
